method: Six deterministic continuous first-invitation runs through 3-8; tutorial kills fast-forwarded, then real update_game dt=.05, nearby bonds/Q/E/skills/revive/dodge/exit. No synthetic high-level team/materials in combat. Graveyard post-run growth probes spend earned materials through real training/promotion functions. Bot timing is not human clear time or success rate.
